title: London Conference: October 2026
text:
London Conference: October 2026

Research Team, Dragonomics Team

Gavekal Research | 22 Oct 2026

At our latest conference in London, Anatole Kaletsky, Will Denyer and Cedric Gemehl examined mounting global macro risks, from the US AI investment boom to France's fiscal troubles and rising bond yields. Tom Holland, AJ Cortese and Tom Miller assessed the impact of the Middle East conflict on energy markets, China's electrification drive and the scramble for critical minerals. Charles Gave joined Tom Holland for a fireside chat on the changing global monetary order and its implications for investors. Laila Khawaja, Thomas Gatley and Christopher Beddor discussed China's technological ambitions and growing tensions with the US. Finally, Louis-Vincent Gave, Anatole and Didier Darcet explored what these developments mean for portfolio construction and global investment strategy.
